title: Our College Career Fair & Campus Visit Guide for Fall 2026
summary: The Marriott Careers team is coming to a campus near you! This semester we’ll be visiting 60+ universities around the country to share the opportunities at Marriott and why it’s a great place to begin your career.
body_markdown:
The Marriott Careers team is back to school and on the move! Did you know our University Recruiting team visits more than 45 universities and colleges every semester to — what else? — meet thousands of incredible students and dish on all things Marriott. Whether you’re about to graduate and are looking for your very first job or just want to explore internships or part-time opportunities, we want to talk to you.


Below, you’ll find an overview of our rockstar University Recruiters as well as a guide to Marriott’s Fall 2026 campus visits. Listed out by state, this guide includes each visit’s date, recruiter extraordinaire, and any extra details like what events we’ll be attending or hosting. See you on campus!


[Your Marriott journey could start here. Whether you’re a student seeking an internship or a recent graduate exploring our Voyage Global Leadership Program in the U.S. or Canada, click here to explore all open early careers opportunities and apply today](https://careers.marriott.com/career-journeys/early-careers/?utm_source=marriottcareers&utm_medium=referralwebsite) !


## Meet Our Recruiters


This expert team will be on the ground visiting dozens of campuses around the U.S. and Canada. Learn a little bit more about them below and keep an eye out for their friendly faces — be sure to say “hey!” when you see them at school!


### Hayley Rice


**Region:** Southeast


**States:** AL, FL, GA, KY, LA, NC, SC, TN, TX


I’m a thrill-seeking adventurer with a serious love for rollercoasters! My passion has taken me across 5 countries, through 67 amusement parks, and onto 313 unique coasters — each one a new adrenaline rush and memory made. Connect with me on a campus in the Southeast or[on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hayley-rice-08b126175/) !
**Alma Mater:** University of Central Florida


### Rani Bernstein


**Region:** Mid-Atlantic


**States:** D.C., MD, & VA


I’m a local coffee shop fanatic and foodie, so send me your recs! I’m new to the DC area, so always looking for great restaurant recommendations. Connect with me on campus or[on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rani-bernstein-b78264127/) and let’s talk all things coffee and food!
**Alma Mater:** Cornell University


### Dani DeCanio


**Region:** Northeast


**States:** DE, CA, MA, ME, MI, NH, NJ, NV, NY, PA, RI, VT, WV


I love a weekend/long weekend adventure, whether it is local, national, or international, I will book it and go! Connect with me on campus or[on LinkedIn.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielle-decanio/)
**Alma Mater:** Virginia Tech


### Ashley Drost


**Region:** AK, AZ, CO, HI, IA, IL, IN, KS, MN, MO, MT, ND, NE, NM, OH, OK, OR, SD, UT, WA, WI, WY. Canada: AB, BC, MB, NB, ON, QC, NS, PEI, SK, NL


When I’m not working, you’ll probably find me outdoors – either cruising down a new biking trail or out for a run. I’m always on the lookout for scenic hiking spots, so send me your favorite local routes! Let’s connect on campus or find me on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashley-drost-848022107/) .
**Alma Mater:** University of Guelph
